title: Why he loves big bands
summary: He loves big-band sound and rhythmic arrangers, citing Shiny Stockings as a drummer's paradise.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Do you prefer working with big bands?
I love them, I love the big bands. I love the big bands.
What do you love about them?

Well, I mean, it's the sounds you get. And when you get a terrific arranger, arrangers that write rhythmically, where, I mean, the instruments almost -- they could do without the drums. You found these kind of arrangers, and then, I mean, it just makes it beautiful. And the thing like -- what was the name of that thing, it was a drummer's paradise and basses? 'Shiny Stockings.'

Yeah, right. Like, a drummer's paradise with all of the little breaks and the different little fill-ins and things there, right. See, you go crazy with something like that. But that's the kind of writing.
